title: Dadachanji group gets back into pharmaceutical glass packaging with Kaisha Pharma
summary: The Group has made an initial investment of €45 million to scale up its operational capabilities, a note from the company said, adding that it would be more global in its approach, as compared to its earlier India-focussed operations
